verdict.rationale: Terraform's built-in `terraform test` framework runs against test-specific, short-lived resources, "preventing any risk to your existing infrastructure or state" (docs-27). Since v1.7 it can also mock provider data so tests need not touch real infrastructure (docs-28). Speculative plans add a non-destructive preview of changes (docs-43, docs-15). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of test isolation, and documented built-in separation of test credentials or accounts (non-mocked tests still provision real resources in whatever provider account is configured).
